title: lever__interview_enhanced duplicates rows when an interview has multiple deleted feedback forms
fix: Join interview_feedback to the live (not deleted) feedback forms first, then left join interview to that; restore the uniqueness test removed in 7829497; add seed rows with two deleted forms on one interview and one live plus one deleted form on another.

steps.name: bug reproduced: main's models, with the new seed rows, fail the restored uniqueness test
steps.run: git apply {patch} && git checkout HEAD -- models/intermediate/int_lever__interview_feedback.sql && cd integration_tests && dbt deps && dbt build --select +lever__interview_enhanced

steps.name: fixed: with the fix, the same build and tests pass
steps.run: git apply {patch} && cd integration_tests && dbt deps && dbt build --select +lever__interview_enhanced

steps.name: nothing else changes: fixwitness on main's own seeds, with only the model change
steps.run: git apply {patch} && git checkout HEAD -- integration_tests models/lever.yml && python -m fixwitness check --base HEAD --no-attacks --out-dir {out}/fw_models

steps.name: the change as submitted: fixwitness on the whole patch (model, test and seed rows)
steps.run: git apply {patch} && python -m fixwitness check --base HEAD --no-attacks --out-dir {out}/fw_patch
